farm-family.title: Farm Family - Build Your Virtual Agricultural Empire
farm-family.slogan: Grow, Harvest, and Thrive in Farm Family
farm-family.description: Experience the joys of farming in Farm Family, where you can grow crops, raise animals, and build your agricultural empire. Manage your farm with simple mouse controls and enjoy a variety of activities. Start your farming journey today and see your small farm grow into a thriving empire!

HomeIframe.title: Farm Family - Virtual Farming Adventure
HomeIframe.description: Immerse yourself in the world of Farm Family, where you can grow crops, raise animals, and build your agricultural empire. Enjoy simple controls and a variety of farming activities.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Farm Family is a virtual farming game where you can grow crops, raise animals, and build your agricultural empire. Experience the joys and challenges of farming!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the given amount of money to open plots of land and grow staple foods like rice and corn.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Earn money from your crops to explore other areas such as growing fruit, taking care of flowers, and raising animals.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Expand your farm and focus on profitable raw materials to increase production.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Plant and harvest a variety of crops to earn money and expand your farm.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Take care of animals and manage their needs to produce valuable resources.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Increase your farm's production by opening new plots of land and focusing on profitable items.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy easy-to-use mouse controls that make farming accessible to all players.
